scope: BlockEdit restricted-member save choices and nonempty-definition retention on empty close
native_engine: Rhino 8.32.26160.13001 x86-64 through ARM64 Wine/FEX on private Xvfb
native_input: Owned classic Win32 Block Edit warning identified by process, class, title and warning text. Public child-button rectangles drove real pointer Yes/No/Cancel clicks. A separate informational warning confirmed all-members release retains the prior definition; its OK button was acknowledged automatically in the final capture.
release_contract: Restricted members are removed from the definition and accepted as world-space model objects with their hidden/locked flags and raw metadata. Group resources and model history replay remain synchronized.
restore_contract: The staged workspace normalizes restricted member visibility/locking and saves them in the definition. Default save rejects without mutation until an explicit decision; cancellation of the native close returns to the editor and the harness then discards.
empty_contract: If the accepted workspace has no members, retain the prior nonempty definition while accepting released model objects and closing the editor. Native instances and the catalog definition stay intact. Already-empty catalog placements remain unsupported.
context_scope: Local context switching rejects restricted active members until they are normalized. Native restriction-warning choices during context navigation, layer-level restrictions and preexisting restricted prototypes are not newly qualified.
comparison_limits: Nine fresh point-member workflows and 45 closed-model states at absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12. Root/member metadata, groups, world positions, flags and logical handle allocation are compared in recorded order. Local tests constrain one-step model Undo/Redo; native history and wider member types are unverified. No GPU or performance measurements.
remaining_scope: Layer-level restrictions and native choices during context switches
Preexisting restricted prototypes and wider geometry
Linked definitions and persistence of active editors
Native selection/history/panel qualification and performance/GPU measurements
